frequency_question: What proportion of major bipartisan energy or infrastructure permitting reform bills introduced with visible committee-level advance signals successfully reach Presidential signature within a 14-month legislative window?
membership_rule: Includes major omnibus energy, grid, or surface transportation bills with permitting reform provisions that advanced past committee or leadership draft stages; excludes minor single-issue technical amendments and pure appropriations riders.

cases.name: Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007
American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (Energy/Grid provisions)

coverage_note: 8 named major legislative efforts containing energy/infrastructure permitting reform components over the last 30 years.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture informal committee stalls that never reached floor debate or major package inclusion.
validity_reason: Legislative procedures and polarization dynamics remain structurally stable through the end of the decade.
